summary: South African army cardiologist Wouter Basson ran apartheid's secret chemical and biological weapons program from 1981, supplying poisons to kill opponents and pursuing a covert sterilization vaccine for Black South Africans, then sold its MDMA.

evidence.note: Basson's birth in 1950, Cape Town upbringing and cardiology career in the SADF
In 1981 the government sends Basson abroad to study CBW programs; Project Coast begins
Operation Barnacle: toxins supplied to kill SWAPO fighters in Namibia, bodies dumped at sea
Poisonings of apartheid opponents abroad; MI5 probes suspicious deaths in the UK
Plots against ANC members in London and a thallium attempt on Mandela
Anti-fertility vaccine meant to sterilize Black women without consent
De Klerk winds down Project Coast; MDMA and quaaludes for crowd control, then sold for profit
1997 sting via dealer Grant Wentzel leads to Basson's arrest and seizure of his files
TRC hearing and criminal trial from October 1999; acquitted as acts were not illegal then
Later misconduct finding set aside in March 2019; he remains free at release

notes: Opening ~25 minutes are general chemical-weapons history (1675 to the Iran-Iraq War), treated as background and excluded from covered_span. Acquittal year 2002 is from general knowledge; the transcript gives only the 1999 trial start. Primary theme could arguably be weapons-arms-trade; genocide chosen per the title and the host's framing of the sterilization project.
